description: Search developer sources in one call: Hacker News stories (Algolia), GitHub repositories (by stars), npm packages (with weekly downloads), PyPI (exact package lookup, PyPI has no search API) and Stack Overflow questions. Each source returns its own list; a source that is rate limited reports an error without failing the call. Params: query (required), sources (default all: hackernews, github, npm, pypi, stackoverflow), limit per source (1 to 20, default 5). Price: $0.0045 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"query":"x402","limit":3}.
name: dev_search
title: Developer Search
